About me

I’m working toward a Bachelor of Business Administration at Pacific States University. My path so far runs through two very different settings: humanitarian field work in Bangladesh and sales leadership in Los Angeles.

I want to build a career in nonprofit work and marketing, where I can combine what I learned listening to people in the field with what I learned leading a team to hit its goals. I also build small web projects in HTML, CSS and JavaScript.

Special Victim Interviewer – MKM Brunei

2019

MKM is the Brunei Council on Social Welfare, a non-governmental organization that helps vulnerable and underprivileged people in Brunei and beyond. In 2019 I worked with MKM in refugee camps in Bangladesh as a Special Victim Interviewer.

I interviewed people one-on-one in Chittagonian and Rohingya, then wrote up each interview as a report in English so the team could act on it. The work taught me to listen carefully, communicate across languages, and write accurately. The identities and details of the people I interviewed are kept private.

  • Interviewing
  • Chittagonian, Rohingya and English
  • Report writing
  • Humanitarian work

Women Empowerment Project – Jonaki’r Alo, Bangladesh

Bangladesh

Jonaki’r Alo is a joint initiative of the NGO Poralekha and Education Sponsorship Asia, Japan. It helps rural women build skills and sell their products.

I worked in its women empowerment project. Women in rural areas made garments that the NGO exported to Japan, and a school taught them skills to support themselves.

  • Community development
  • Women’s empowerment
  • Skills training
